capabilities: Display a sidecar panel for the focused file based on a sidecar-panel property
Map tags to panel files in settings
Cascade multiple panel files into one sidecar
Embed widgets such as meta-bind inputs and buttons that edit the parent file
extras: One documented example (a PDF-export button) depends on a pull request the author issued to obsidian-meta-bind, so it may not work with the released plugin. A roadmap lists unfinished items such as metadatamenu fileClass support.
motivation: The author wanted contextual buttons and metadata input lists visible beside the file being edited, so meeting attendees could be changed without scrolling.
problem: Obsidian has no per-file contextual side panel, so editing buttons or metadata inputs means scrolling to the top of a note or opening other files.

relations.evidence: this enables you to use plugins such as obsidian-meta-bind to create INPUT fields

summary: Adds a context-dependent right sidebar panel whose content is chosen per file via a sidecar-panel property or tag-to-panel mappings.
